## AI Automation Services
### The Safety Net — never miss a lead again.
Your missed calls, after-hours enquiries, and dead leads get answered in seconds.
- Missed-call textback
- After-hours AI answering
- Monthly leak report (every lead you would have lost, listed)
Included: Live in 3 days. Month-to-month.

### The AI Sales Department — follow-up, booking, reviews, done.
A full AI follow-up and booking system wired into how your team actually sells.
- 7-touch AI follow-up sequence
- Website chat that books
- Honest review requests + AI-drafted replies
- 90-day CRM nurture
Included: Live in 2 weeks. 90-day pilot.

### The Closer — a voice AI receptionist.
An AI receptionist that answers the phone, answers real questions, and books the appointment mid-call.
- Inbound voice AI (Twilio + ElevenLabs)
- Live calendar booking + SMS confirmation
- Full call transcripts + CRM logging
Included: Live in 3 weeks. Built on the Safety Net.

Pricing depends on scope — most builds land between a one-time setup and a flat monthly. Book a free consult for an exact number.

## Recent Projects
My own demo builds and offer systems. Each tag is the type of business the build is for — not a named client.

1. Missed-Call Textback (Home services). Problem: Calls missed after hours went to voicemail — and never came back. Build: Twilio number + n8n: every missed call gets a text in under a minute, with a booking link. Tech: n8n, Twilio, Claude.
2. The 7-Touch Follow-Up Engine (Small sales teams). Problem: 400 dead leads sitting in the CRM, nobody following up. Build: A 7-touch AI sequence that personalises every message from the lead's own notes — prompts, not canned scripts. Tech: n8n, Claude, GoHighLevel.
3. Voice AI Receptionist (Clinics & local services). Problem: The phone rings while the team is with customers. Voicemail loses the booking. Build: Voice AI answers, answers real questions, books into the live calendar mid-call, texts a confirmation. Tech: Retell / Vapi, Twilio, ElevenLabs, n8n.
4. Website Chat That Books (Any small business). Problem: Website visitors leave without asking anything. Build: An AI chat agent trained on the business's own services and prices — answers and books, doesn't deflect. Tech: Claude, n8n, GoHighLevel.
5. Review Engine (Local services). Problem: Happy customers never leave reviews; unhappy ones always do. Build: Honest review requests after every job, AI-drafted replies to every review. No cherry-picking, no review gating. Tech: n8n, GoHighLevel, Claude.
6. 90-Day CRM Nurture (Sales teams). Problem: Old leads go cold because nobody has time to re-activate them. Build: A 90-day nurture that re-engages cold leads with personalised check-ins until they reply or opt out. Tech: n8n, Claude, GoHighLevel.
7. Lead Qualifier Agent (Home services). Problem: Every enquiry gets the same reply, qualified or not. Build: An agent that asks the right questions, scores the lead, and books only the real ones into the calendar. Tech: Claude, n8n, Calendly / GoHighLevel.
8. Appointment Booking Agent (Clinics & trades). Problem: Booking means phone tag — three calls to set one appointment. Build: An agent that offers real slots, confirms, reminds, and reschedules — no human in the loop. Tech: n8n, Twilio, GoHighLevel.

## How it works — 3 steps
1. Discovery call (free, 30 min). We find the leak — the missed calls, the dead leads, the follow-up nobody does. You leave with the number, whether we work together or not.
2. Build in days. I build the system on your number, your calendar, your CRM. You test it live before it goes live for customers.
3. You approve, it runs. It answers, follows up, and books — while you work. Monthly report shows every lead it saved.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What does an Agentic AI consultant do?
A: I build AI agents that do real sales work for small businesses — answering missed calls, following up with leads, booking appointments, and replying to reviews. Not chatbots that deflect. Agents that complete the job, then log it in your CRM.

Q: How much does an AI automation project cost?
A: It depends on scope. A single system like the missed-call textback is a one-time setup plus a flat monthly; a full AI sales department is a bigger build with a monthly that covers running it. Book a free consult and I'll give you an exact number — no hourly billing, no surprises.

Q: How long does it take to build an AI follow-up system?
A: The Safety Net goes live in 3 days. A full follow-up and booking system takes about 2 weeks. The voice receptionist takes about 3 weeks. You test everything live before customers ever see it.

Q: Do you work with US companies?
A: Yes. I'm based in Toronto and work remotely with US and Canadian small businesses. Everything is delivered remotely and billed in USD for US clients — no visa, no relocation, no travel needed.

Q: What tools do you build with?
A: n8n for automation, Claude for the AI brain, Twilio and ElevenLabs for voice, and GoHighLevel for the CRM and follow-up. You own the accounts, the number, and the data — nothing is locked to me.
